nary_nodes.label: Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries
evidence: Ukraine said it has hit two oil refineries in multiple strikes deep inside Russia
President Volodymyr Zelensky said the Bashneft-Novoil and Slavneft-Yanos refineries were struck in the attacks
Ukraine said it has hit two oil refineries in multiple strikes deep inside Russia with patrol boats and other vessels in the Black Sea also hit
President Volodymyr Zelensky said the Bashneft-Novoil and Slavneft-Yanos refineries were struck in the attacks aimed at limiting oil revenues Moscow 'uses to finance' its war

nary_nodes.label: Russian attack casualties
evidence: Ukraine said at least 11 people were killed in Russian attacks
Ukraine said at least 11 people were killed in Russian attacks, and the southern city of Kherson reported a total blackout

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky's statement on Ukrainian attacks
evidence: Zelensky said on Thursday that the struck Bashneft-Novoil refinery in Russia's Bashkortostan republic was about 1,300km (808 miles) from the Ukrainian border

Zelensky said on Thursday that the struck Bashneft-Novoil refinery in Russia's Bashkortostan republic was about 1,300km (808 miles) from the Ukrainian border, whereas Slavneft-Yanos was almost 700km (435 miles) away

nary_nodes.label: Russian drone attack on Balakliya
evidence: three people were killed in the town of Balakliya, Kharkiv region, in an overnight Russian drone attack
three people were killed in the town of Balakliya, Kharkiv region, in an overnight Russian drone attack, the country's state emergencies service DSNS said

nary_nodes.label: Internet disruption in Kherson
evidence: NetBlocks told BBC Verify it had observed 'deep disruption' to connectivity in the Kherson region
NetBlocks told BBC Verify it had observed 'deep disruption' to connectivity in the Kherson region. According to telemetry data, internet connectivity fell to about 31% at its lowest overnight
